text:
kevin: Heads up — after we changed the route-split weights for /v1/embeddings (rollout s-2026-04) p95 on the Console moved ~300ms but raw telemetry p95 stayed flat. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/emb-pctl

anya: which percentile window is Console using? could be a rollup artifact.

kevin: Console shows p50/p95/p99 with a small badge "rollup". I ran a raw query:
```
SELECT tdigest_percentile(latency_ms, 0.95) FROM service.latency
WHERE route='/v1/embeddings' AND env='prod' AND time > now() - interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY minute
```
it reports ~180ms across the time window. Console p95 was ~480ms after the weight flip.

console-bot: Note: last config change s-2026-04 applied at 1799901033 by infra-bot.

jarvis: two plausible things: 1) merged-rollup uses decaying tdigest with reservoir bias which inflates tail when new route variant introduces infrequent slow tails; 2) Console aggregates across client vs gateway origins differently than raw query.

mira: how many samples are we talking about? tdigest instability shows up under ~200 samples.

kevin: sample counts are small per-minute: ~40-60. But over 30m it's ~1200 total. The spike looks concentrated in one 2m bucket.

anya: if the spike is in one bucket, Console's rollup windowing (it stitches tdigest sketches across minutes with a decay factor) can hold onto heavy tail longer than raw per-minute recompute. That could explain discrepancy.

infra-bot: Re-agg job queued: reagg-1799901100.

product: any chance legend labels are collapsing origin tags? Users saw 'client' in the tooltip yesterday and blamed SDK. We should avoid that.

jarvis: agreed — UI mapping simplified merged-rollup -> client in micro charts. we should change it to show 'merged-rollup (by origin)' and expose the origin in the hover.

mira: temporary mitigation: add sample-count and algorithm label next to each percentile in the UI, e.g. "p95: 480ms (tdigest rollup, 45 samples/min)". that'll reduce confusion.

kevin: walkthrough I did: pulled raw points for the slow bucket and found two outliers that were gateway-retries with 1.1s latencies. traces: https://traces.redwood/emb-ff1 and https://traces.redwood/emb-ff2

sre-oncall: marking this as follow-up. Can we set a dashboard annotation when route-splits happen? It would help correlate.

anya: good idea — console could show a small banner when a routing policy/weight change happened within the chart's window (with link to rollout). I filed a tiny ticket: RNWD-ENG-2842.

kevin: re-agg finished and Console p95 is now ~190ms after reprocessing. The UI change to show "rollup (decay tdigest)" in tooltip is helpful.

product: we'll prioritize the legend revert + sample-count in the latency pane this sprint. thanks team.

kevin: closing — main takeaways: low per-bucket samples + decaying tdigest rollup + transient gateway retry outliers caused the visual discrepancy. UI should be explicit about algorithm and sample counts.
